title: Passkeys
desc: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. Passkeys include user verification, so no authenticator code is needed. Only the public key is stored here.
unsupported: This browser does not support Passkeys. Passkeys also require HTTPS or localhost and a domain name (IP addresses are not accepted by browsers).
addHint: After you continue, your browser or device will ask you to confirm with a fingerprint, face or PIN.
deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Enter your current password to confirm.
